Summary

Hi! My name is Serhii. I am 34 years old. I have been working as a plumber for over 10 years in Ukraine.

In my free time, I like to explore new technology and integrate it into my everyday life, do web development, keep up with IT news, as well as repair, assemble and build PCs and fix various devices. I learn quickly and get to know things as I go along.

I enjoy my own company and like to spend time by myself, a little away from large crowds. I don’t have any close friends — I am my own best friend, but I can also be a good and loyal friend to others.

As for me as a person, I am quite modest and shy, so I need some time to open up and gain confidence in people. I am perhaps a bit of an introvert in my own way — I have my own rhythm of life, and I like to think out loud.

I am very emotional, quiet and reserved.

I'm not the first to contact you, and I can be very direct.
